sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Tower Defense Clash are simple yet engaging. Players start by building towers on the free spots on the map, which will automatically attack monsters that come near them. As the monsters approach, players can upgrade their towers to increase their damage output and range. Players can also use spells to clear clusters of monsters or to give their towers a temporary boost.

      In addition to building towers and upgrading them, players can also combine different towers and elements to create powerful strategies. For example, players can use a combination of fire and ice towers to create a powerful elemental attack. Players can also use magic towers to create a shield around their kingdom, protecting it from monsters.

      One of the key features of Tower Defense Clash is its tower variety. The game features a wide range of tower types, each with its unique abilities and strengths. Players can choose from fire, ice, lightning, and dark towers, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Players can also combine different tower types to create a powerful strategy that suits their playstyle.

      Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Tower Defense Clash are engaging and addictive. Players will love the simplicity and depth of the game's mechanics, and the variety of tower types will keep them engaged for hours. Whether you're a seasoned strategy player or a casual gamer, Tower Defense Clash is sure to appeal to you.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks

      Another tip is to use spells to clear clusters of monsters or to give your towers a temporary boost. Spells can be a powerful tool in your tower defense arsenal, so be sure to use them wisely.
